question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **become**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Become **is a linking verb that means to begin to be something.

 
 
• **"are becoming"**; We use am, are, is + the -ing form of the verb in the **present continuous** tense.
 
• "**Become**" is the first form of the verb also known as the base form of the verb. it is used to create the **simple present tense**.
 
• **"have become"**; is used in the **present perfect tense**, which involves an event that took place at an indefinite point in the past and continues to the present.
 
• "**became**" is the** past form of become** it is used when the thing already happened in the past some time ago.
 
 
 
• As we can see that the given paragraph is written in the **simple present tense**, therefore '**become**' should be used as the 1st form of the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
